description: This file is a Streamlit application script for a medical exam preparation chatbot that uses Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to answer questions based on textbook content. It sets up the UI, manages session state, loads chapters and vector store, and defines an async function to generate answers by retrieving relevant text chunks and querying an OpenAI model.

classes.name: LocalVectorStore
classes.description: A class for managing a local vector store used for similarity search in the RAG process.

classes.name: EmbeddingManager
classes.description: A class responsible for generating embeddings for text queries.

methods.name: generate_rag_answer
methods.description: Asynchronous function that retrieves relevant text chunks based on the question, constructs a prompt, and queries the OpenAI API to generate an answer.
